description: El planeta es nuestro hogar y protegerlo es vital. Como humanidad, solo nosotros podemos salvarnos, pero la tecnología está aquí para amplificar nuestra fuerza. Usando datos de la NASA (SMAP, Landsat), crearemos herramientas para que los agricultores tomen mejores decisiones. Caminemos juntos al futuro
summary:
Introduction
As the effects of climate change become a part of our daily lives, finding new solutions is an increasingly urgent response. Our team focuses on how climate change impacts the agricultural industry. For years, increasingly erratic weather has made field conditions unpredictable, raising serious concerns about the stability of the food industry. 

To address this, our team has developed a solution that combines satellite data with a soil-testing device powered by the JXBS-3001 sensor. Using Bluetooth proximity communication, the device transfers data to a basic computer running stock software, where the information is organized into an Excel-style table. The user then imports this structured data into our dedicated platform, which converts it into a lightweight, visually intuitive mobile app, making it easy to access and carry field data anywhere.
details:
Is a decision-support ecosystem that gives the user a platform to view the parameters (moisture, temperature, electrical conductivity/EC, pH, and NPK) read from sensor nodes buried 1 meter deep. The information is sent via LoRa radio to an ESP32, stored on a microSD card, and synced to the FieldShift app with cross validated information from NASA satellite weather models.

Provides real time monitoring, it works offline in rural areas and boost estimated field production by up to 7.5%

ESP32-S3 microcontrollers, SX1262 LoRa radios, JXBS-3001 probes, MAX3485 converters, C/C++ , cloud databases, and NASA POWER/SMAP APIs.

Combines the macro data form the NASA with the micro data of the ground sensors, it automatically sorts urgent alerts to the very top of the app and triggers a full-screen emergency overlay for the duration of the emergency

Designed to be low cost scalability, have rural offline durability, easy to charged the battery and give it maintenance and targeting the local crop needs
